title: High-Speed Data Acquisition System — Overview and definition
t: High-Speed Data Acquisition System — Overview and definition
description: Captures synchronized measurements at megahertz to gigahertz rates.
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Captures synchronized measurements at megahertz to gigahertz rates. High-speed DAQ captures transient events — impacts, detonations (lab-scale), switching — with deep memory, precise triggering, and picosecond channel skew. Real implementations include Spectrum, Keysight digitizers, and NI high-speed modules. It streams to RAID without drops and timestamps with IRIG/GPS.
capabilities: MS/s to GS/s sampling with deep memory
